mapper.select: with res as ( select r.result_id, r.equip_id, r.occurred_at, r.recorded_at, round((r.good_qty + r.scrap_qty + r.rework_qty + r.repair_qty) / wp.units_per_cycle, 12) as cycles from prd_result r join prd_wo_proc wp on wp.wo_proc_id = r.wo_proc_id where r.equip_id is not null and r.occurred_at >= #{since} and r.reversal_of_id is null and not exists (select 1 from prd_result v where v.reversal_of_id = r.result_id) ), st as ( select s.state_log_id, s.equip_id, s.start_at, s.end_at from cms_equip_state_log s where s.state_cat = 'PRD' and s.end_at is not null and s.start_at >= #{since} ), cand as ( select c.counter_id, 'RESULT' as src_kind, res.result_id as src_id, res.cycles as qty from cms_counter c join res on res.equip_id = c.equip_id where c.use_yn = 'Y' and c.target_type = 'EQUIP' and c.counter_kind in ('SHOTS', 'CYCLES') and res.recorded_at >= c.created_at union all select c.counter_id, 'RESULT', res.result_id, res.cycles from cms_counter c join mst_asset_install i on i.asset_id = c.asset_id and i.void_yn = 'N' join res on res.equip_id = i.equip_id and res.occurred_at >= i.installed_at and (i.removed_at is null or res.occurred_at < i.removed_at) where c.use_yn = 'Y' and c.target_type = 'ASSET' and c.counter_kind in ('SHOTS', 'CYCLES') and res.recorded_at >= c.created_at union all select c.counter_id, 'STATE', st.state_log_id, round(extract(epoch from st.end_at - greatest(st.start_at, c.created_at)) / 3600, 12) from cms_counter c join st on st.equip_id = c.equip_id where c.use_yn = 'Y' and c.target_type = 'EQUIP' and c.counter_kind = 'RUN_HOURS' and st.end_at > c.created_at union all select c.counter_id, 'STATE', st.state_log_id, round(sum(greatest(0, extract(epoch from least(st.end_at, coalesce(i.removed_at, st.end_at)) - greatest(st.start_at, i.installed_at, c.created_at)))) / 3600, 12) from cms_counter c join mst_asset_install i on i.asset_id = c.asset_id and i.void_yn = 'N' join st on st.equip_id = i.equip_id and st.end_at > i.installed_at and (i.removed_at is null or st.start_at < i.removed_at) where c.use_yn = 'Y' and c.target_type = 'ASSET' and c.counter_kind = 'RUN_HOURS' and st.end_at > c.created_at group by c.counter_id, st.state_log_id ) select cand.counter_id, cand.src_kind, cand.src_id, cand.qty from cand where not exists (select 1 from cms_counter_src s where s.counter_id = cand.counter_id and s.src_kind = cand.src_kind and s.src_id = cand.src_id) order by cand.counter_id, cand.src_kind, cand.src_id limit #{limit}

insert into cms_counter_reading (comp_cd, counter_id, read_at, gauge_value, delta_qty, reset_yn, source, remark, recorded_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{counterId}, #{readAt}, null, #{delta}, 'N', 'AUTO', #{remark}, #{by}) returning reading_id
mapper.insert: insert into cms_counter_src (comp_cd, counter_id, src_kind, src_id, reading_id, qty) values (hb_current_comp(), #{s.counterId}, #{s.srcKind}, #{s.srcId}, #{readingId}, #{s.qty})
mapper.select: select scale from cms_counter where counter_id = #{counterId}
select coalesce(sum(qty), 0) from cms_counter_src where counter_id = #{counterId}
select coalesce(sum(delta_qty), 0) from cms_counter_reading where counter_id = #{counterId} and source = 'AUTO'
